life_payments.description: All distinct numeric life-payment amounts explicitly stated in the card rules. Include payments made by any player; exclude life gain, life loss that is not a payment, and amounts not readable as numbers. Return each distinct value once, in any order. Use [] when none are readable; do not reconstruct missing text.

opponent_declines_returns_to_you.description: Whether an opposing creature that dies returns under your control when its controller declines the life payment.
